title: VCNIA Trust Event
description: A Trust Event records a trust update derived from trace records, gratitude events, verification signals, and contribution history within the VCNIA value circulation stack.

type.description: The fixed event type for a VCNIA trust event.

trust_event_id.description: A unique identifier for the trust event.

subject_id.description: The human, AI agent, system, project, trace, or contributor whose trust state is being updated.

related_trace_ids.description: Optional list of trace records related to this trust event.

related_gratitude_ids.description: Optional list of gratitude events used as input for this trust update.

trust_delta.description: The change in trust score caused by this event. Positive values increase trust; negative values decrease trust.

trust_score_after.description: Optional normalized trust score after this event has been applied.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this trust event was issued.

trust_dimensions.description: Optional dimension-specific trust changes or scores.

originality.description: Trust change or score related to originality.

reliability.description: Trust change or score related to reliability.

usefulness.description: Trust change or score related to usefulness.

integrity.description: Trust change or score related to integrity and low manipulation risk.

citation_quality.description: Trust change or score related to citation and reference quality.

verification_quality.description: Trust change or score related to verification strength.

long_term_value.description: Trust change or score related to durable contribution value.

network_contribution.description: Trust change or score related to contribution to the broader network.

collaboration_quality.description: Trust change or score related to collaborative behavior.

governance_alignment.description: Trust change or score related to alignment with governance principles.

verification_status.description: Optional verification state of the trust event.

risk_flags.description: Optional list of risk signals associated with this trust event.

decay_applied.description: Whether trust decay was applied in this event.

decay_factor.description: Decay factor applied to previous trust.

governance_ref.description: Optional reference to the governance rule or policy used to issue this trust event.

policy_uri.description: Optional URI pointing to the governance policy.

timestamp.description: The time when the trust event was issued, expressed in ISO 8601 date-time format.

context.description: Optional contextual information about the project, task, workflow, layer, or system in which the trust event was issued.
